summary: The first mismatch was caused by the missing uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dise effect at the monster-to-monster AD_PEST path. mhitm_ad_pest copies Pestilence’s attack, changes it to AD_DISE, and calls the helper; the helper zeroes damage against S_FUNGUS, Ghouls, and monsters defended against disease. The port now reaches that guard, preserving the Red Mold and restoring the later passive RNG. The later corpse_chance and passivemm differences were downstream consequences, not passivemm defects.

source.branch: For a monster-pair hit, mhitm_ad_dise uses the monster defender’s data: S_FUNGUS, PM_GHOUL, or defended(mdef, AD_DISE) sets mhm.damage to zero; all other defenders take normal damage. A hero attacker goes to this same branch, although the source comment says it is unreachable because every AD_DISE species (Juiblex, Demogorgon, and Scorpius) has M2_NOPOLY. The separate monster-attacks-hero arm emits hitmsg and retains normal damage only when diseasemu succeeds. The dispatcher’s active monster-pair and monster-to-hero callers are mdamagem and hitmu; damageum reaches its hero-attacker arm only for a valid polymorph, which the source monster table excludes.
callers: uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_pest: the monster-pair branch copies mattk, sets alt_attk.adtyp=AD_DISE, and calls mhitm_ad_dise; the monster-to-hero branch emits the fever-and-chills message and calls diseasemu.
uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping: the AD_DISE switch case directly calls mhitm_ad_dise and the AD_PEST case calls mhitm_ad_pest.
mhitm.c:mdamagem at line 1059 calls uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping for monster-pair attacks; js/mhitm.js:mdamagem is already wired to the same dispatcher.
mhitu.c:hitmu at line 1191 calls uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping for monster-to-hero attacks; js/mhitu.js:hitmu is already wired to the same dispatcher.

uhitm.c:damageum at line 4854 calls uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping for hero-to-monster attacks; js/uhitm.js:damageum is already wired to the same dispatcher, but no valid hero polymorph can select AD_DISE because all source species with that attack are M2_NOPOLY.
dependencies: uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_pest source caller branch must call the JS helper instead of note_unported.
uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping AD_DISE switch arm must call the JS helper instead of unported.
Existing JS defended(..., AD_DISE) preserves the C monster-defense predicate.
Existing JS diseasemu() and hitmsg() implement the helper’s non-monster-pair source arm.

evidence: Current saved v47 queue entry: C and JS first disagree at zero-based step 138, screen index 138. C shows Pestilence touching the Red Mold and the monster remains alive; JS shows the tourist glyph at that map position after the target dies. At that action C next logs d(2,4)=2 in passivemm(mhitm.c:1326), while JS next logs rn2(3)=2 from corpse_chance after the Red Mold was killed. This places the causative difference before passivemm.

Upstream uhitm.c:4593-4619 defines the entire missing helper. Its monster-pair arm sets mhm.damage=0 for S_FUNGUS, PM_GHOUL, or defended(mdef, AD_DISE), and leaves ordinary damage unchanged otherwise.

Upstream uhitm.c:3808-3833 shows mhitm_ad_pest’s exact call: it copies mattk, changes adtyp to AD_DISE, then discards the void helper result. JS uhitm.js:mhitm_ad_pest currently substitutes note_unported in this monster-pair arm.

Upstream uhitm.c:4782-4825 contains the direct AD_DISE caller in mhitm_adtyping. JS uhitm.js currently stops that arm at unported("mhitm_ad_dise"). The complete source task must wire both existing callers.

The selected v47 recipe places a forced hostile Pestilence and hostile Red Mold under Conflict, then waits for the adjacent monster fight. Its full replay now matches and reaches mhitm_ad_pest -> mhitm_ad_dise before the Red Mold passive attack.
The admitted v20 pestilence-touches-wizard-v20-more-corrected case is a distinct matching monster-to-hero entry to mhitm_ad_pest; a fresh differential matches its full 48-step segment.

New independent C-first recordings cover direct AD_DISE dispatcher entries: Scorpius versus a stone golem exercises mdamagem -> mhitm_adtyping -> mhitm_ad_dise through 156 steps, and Scorpius versus the hero exercises hitmu -> mhitm_adtyping -> mhitm_ad_dise through the disease action at step 79 in an 80-step replay. Both fresh differentials match completely.

The AD_DISE hero-attacker branch is source-tested but has no valid runtime producer: monsters.h defines Juiblex, Demogorgon, and Scorpius as M2_NOPOLY, and uhitm.c explicitly comments that a hero cannot polymorph into a monster with this attack.
